author: Evan Edinger
description:
When a city is designed like a maze, certain crimes get more difficult to stop. 
Big shout out to Addi for being such a lovely guide for our trip to Morocco. Big rec! https://a0fjao.short.gy/E9uQko

Sometimes I get invited out to certain places to vlog my experiences. As the times have evolved as has the demands for modern YouTube and such, I’ve felt a bit like I’ve lost my vlogging mojo. I recorded so much from my trip to Morocco, but everything exists in a state between either travel vlog (easy to edit and share experiences) and my modern edutainment style main channel content. Been sitting on all the footage for months without a vlog to tell the tale on my travel channel. Feels bad. But the experience of nearly getting scammed in Fez, and the intriguing design of the city and its street signs was a moment that stood out to me, and one I would talk about with friends, so I thought it might be nice to pull this one out and try and make a video here about it. I hope you liked it! Addi
title: Why Police Can’t Stop Morocco’s Most Famous Scam
